text: Yes, the property lost tree cover in 2019. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) detected a 1.8-hectare loss of planted forest (Pinus species) that year, which was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data showing the area was forested in 2020. The loss met the minimum event size (0.5 ha) and was classified as tree cover loss under the 30% canopy threshold. Additional small patches (<0.5 ha) of loss were also observed but not counted as part of the event.
